name: Toll Brothers, Inc.
moat_justification: Luxury brand, affluent less rate-sensitive buyers, land optioning and design-studio pricing power have held ROIC proxy at 19.4-25.6% in FY2021-25, but homebuilding is cyclical, land and construction are contestable inputs, gross margin has faded from 27.9% (FY2024) to 25.1% (FY2025) and Q3 FY26 adjusted margin fell to 25.6% from 27.5%, and pre-2021 ROIC proxy ran only ~11-13% — a moderate/narrow moat, not a wide one.
fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 12 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
BUYBACK_TAILWIND: share count shrinking 5.4%/yr — already credited via the growth adjustment
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2024 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base

DEBT_TAGS_BLANK: no debt tag reports for the latest fiscal year — net debt is UNKNOWN (not zero); no leverage verdict is possible from the engine, state the balance sheet from the filing in analysis.md
WIDE_SCENARIO_SPREAD: super-bull IV is 4.5x super-bear IV — uncertainty is huge; confidence should not be high
TIER_BAND: bear-case tier D (9.8%) vs bull-case tier B (16.0%) — the verdict spans tiers; size any position to the bear end
one_liner: Quality luxury builder, moat 5/10 — does not clear 15% at $133.70 on TTM owner's earnings (13.4% weighted IRR, IV@15% $115.53); it clears 15% only below ~$115.53, and the bear case is Tier D, so size to the bear end.
moat_for: Luxury brand and affluent, less mortgage-rate-sensitive buyer base — industry-low 2.6% cancellation rate in Q3 FY26
Pricing power: average delivered price ~$996,000 in Q3 FY26, above guidance high end, on mix and personalization
Land discipline: ~75,500 owned or controlled lots, ~58% optioned — capital-light land pipeline supporting 8-10%/yr community growth
Returns: ROIC proxy 19.4-25.6% across FY2021-25 and gross margin 25.1-27.9% in FY2024-25, well above most builders through the recent cycle
moat_against: Pure cyclicality: housing demand is hostage to mortgage rates and consumer confidence — Q3 FY26 deliveries fell 10% and revenue 9.7% YoY
Margin erosion already visible: gross margin 27.9% (FY2024) to 25.1% (FY2025); Q3 FY26 adjusted gross margin 25.6% vs 27.5% a year earlier, SG&A deleveraging
Land, labor and lots are bought in contestable markets — no owned scarce input or switching cost; D.R. Horton, PulteGroup and local luxury builders contest every community
Through-cycle returns are mid-teens, not wide-moat: ROIC proxy was only ~11-13% in FY2016-20
